_note: Schematic organelle models. Shapes are illustrative. Sizes and function text come from the catalog compartment named in `compartment`.

summary.en: Double-membrane organelle that makes most of the cell's ATP by oxidative phosphorylation.
summary.zh-Hant: 雙層膜細胞器，經氧化磷酸化製造細胞大部分 ATP。

text.en: Smooth membrane with porins, permeable to small molecules.
text.zh-Hant: 平滑嘅膜，含孔蛋白，小分子可以通過。

text.en: Narrow gap between the two membranes where protons accumulate.
text.zh-Hant: 兩層膜之間嘅窄間隙，質子喺此積聚。

text.en: Holds the respiratory complexes and ATP synthase. Complex I (PDB 5XTD) sits here.
text.zh-Hant: 載有呼吸鏈複合體同 ATP 合成酶。Complex I（PDB 5XTD）位於此處。

text.en: Folds of the inner membrane that raise its surface area.
text.zh-Hant: 內膜嘅摺疊，增加表面積。

text.en: Enzymes of the citric acid cycle and fatty acid oxidation, plus mitochondrial DNA.
text.zh-Hant: 含檸檬酸循環同脂肪酸氧化嘅酵素，以及粒線體 DNA。

text.en: Small circular genome in the matrix.
text.zh-Hant: 基質內嘅小型環狀基因組。

summary.en: Holds the chromosomes inside a double membrane studded with pores.
summary.zh-Hant: 染色體藏於佈滿核孔嘅雙層膜之內。

text.en: Two membranes with the perinuclear space between them, continuous with the rough ER.
text.zh-Hant: 兩層膜，中間係核周間隙，同粗面內質網相連。

text.en: Large protein channels that control traffic between nucleus and cytoplasm.
text.zh-Hant: 大型蛋白通道，控制細胞核同細胞質之間嘅運輸。

text.en: DNA wound on histones, filling the nuclear interior.
text.zh-Hant: DNA 纏繞組織蛋白，充滿核內。

text.en: Dense region where ribosomal RNA is made and ribosomes begin to assemble.
text.zh-Hant: 致密區域，製造核糖體 RNA，並開始組裝核糖體。

summary.en: Stacked flattened sacs coated with ribosomes. Makes secreted and membrane proteins.
summary.zh-Hant: 由扁平囊疊成，表面佈滿核糖體。合成分泌蛋白同膜蛋白。

text.en: Flattened membrane sheets enclosing the lumen.
text.zh-Hant: 包住內腔嘅扁平膜片。

text.en: Space inside the sheets where new proteins fold.
text.zh-Hant: 片層內部，新合成嘅蛋白質喺此摺疊。

text.en: Bound to the outer face. The 80S ribosome (PDB 4UG0) can be opened in Module B.
text.zh-Hant: 附於外表面。80S 核糖體（PDB 4UG0）可喺模組 B 開啟。

summary.en: Stack of cisternae that modifies and sorts proteins from the ER.
summary.zh-Hant: 一疊扁囊，修飾並分揀來自內質網嘅蛋白質。

text.en: Receives vesicles from the ER.
text.zh-Hant: 接收來自內質網嘅囊泡。

text.en: Enzymes here trim and add sugars to proteins.
text.zh-Hant: 此處嘅酵素修剪並為蛋白質加上糖基。

text.en: Sorts finished proteins into vesicles leaving the stack.
text.zh-Hant: 將完成嘅蛋白質分揀入離開高爾基體嘅囊泡。

text.en: Small vesicles carrying cargo between compartments.
text.zh-Hant: 喺各區室之間運送貨物嘅小囊泡。

summary.en: Membrane-bound sac of digestive enzymes that breaks down worn-out organelles and material taken up from outside.
summary.zh-Hant: 膜包圍嘅消化酵素囊，分解老化嘅細胞器同由外界攝入嘅物質。

text.en: Single membrane that keeps the enzymes away from the rest of the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 單層膜，令酵素同細胞其餘部分隔開。

text.en: Acidic interior where the hydrolases work.
text.zh-Hant: 酸性內部，水解酵素喺此運作。

text.en: Enzymes that digest proteins, lipids, sugars and nucleic acids.
text.zh-Hant: 消化蛋白質、脂質、糖同核酸嘅酵素。

summary.en: Small single-membrane organelle that oxidises fatty acids and other substrates and breaks down the hydrogen peroxide this produces.
summary.zh-Hant: 細小嘅單層膜細胞器，氧化脂肪酸同其他底物，並分解由此產生嘅過氧化氫。

text.en: Single membrane around the matrix.
text.zh-Hant: 包住基質嘅單層膜。

text.en: Holds oxidases and catalase.
text.zh-Hant: 含氧化酶同過氧化氫酶。

text.en: Crystalline core of enzyme in some species and cell types.
text.zh-Hant: 部分物種同細胞類型有酵素結晶核心。

summary.en: Thinnest cytoskeletal fibre: two strands of actin subunits twisted together. Drives cell shape, crawling and muscle contraction.
summary.zh-Hant: 最幼嘅細胞骨架纖維：兩條肌動蛋白亞基鏈互相扭成。負責細胞形狀、爬行同肌肉收縮。

text.en: Globular subunits stacked into a helical filament.
text.zh-Hant: 球狀亞基堆疊成螺旋纖維。

text.en: Fast-growing end where subunits are added.
text.zh-Hant: 生長較快、加入亞基嘅一端。

text.en: Slow-growing end where subunits come off.
text.zh-Hant: 生長較慢、亞基脫離嘅一端。

summary.en: Rope-like fibre of twisted strands. Gives cells mechanical strength; keratins and lamins are examples.
summary.zh-Hant: 由扭合鏈組成嘅繩狀纖維，賦予細胞機械強度；角蛋白同核纖層蛋白就係例子。

text.en: Elongated protein strands wound around each other like a rope.
text.zh-Hant: 細長蛋白鏈互相盤繞，似繩索。

text.en: Where neighbouring units overlap and lock together.
text.zh-Hant: 相鄰單位重疊並鎖合嘅位置。

summary.en: Hollow tube built from α- and β-tubulin dimers. Forms tracks for transport and the spindle for cell division.
summary.zh-Hant: 由 α-微管蛋白同 β-微管蛋白二聚體組成嘅中空管，構成運輸軌道同細胞分裂嘅紡錘體。

text.en: One half of each tubulin dimer.
text.zh-Hant: 每個微管蛋白二聚體嘅一半。

text.en: The other half; exposed at the plus end.
text.zh-Hant: 另一半；暴露喺正端。

text.en: Empty core running along the tube.
text.zh-Hant: 沿管伸延嘅空心中軸。

summary.en: Main microtubule-organising centre of an animal cell: a pair of centrioles inside a cloud of protein.
summary.zh-Hant: 動物細胞主要嘅微管組織中心：一對中心粒被蛋白質團包圍。

text.en: Two short barrels at right angles, each a ring of microtubule blades.
text.zh-Hant: 兩個互相垂直嘅短桶，各由一圈微管片組成。

text.en: Protein cloud around the centrioles that nucleates microtubules.
text.zh-Hant: 圍繞中心粒、啟動微管形成嘅蛋白質團。

text.en: Microtubules growing out from the cloud.
text.zh-Hant: 由蛋白質團向外生長嘅微管。
